## Design decisions recorded at implementation

Full rulings in ADR-0314; the load-bearing ones:

- **Hosted coordinates are typed `n/a{class}`, never
  coerced.** A component-level axis is native-only;
  configuration-level axes admit a hosted row only where
  its `supported|partial` conditionality covers the
  coordinate; disagreeing hosted rows produce
  `unknown{hosted_rows_disagree}` — never averaged.
- **One `MatchSpec` per surface** — differing match specs
  refuse `IncommensurableMatchSpec`; a surface is only
  ever a comparison under one matching discipline.
- **Below-minimum designs emit an `insufficient` report**
  — a durable, auditable record (with the refit debt
  record) rather than a silent thin fit.
- **Strata never pool silently** — `filters.aggregate =
  pooled` raises `StrataPooledUnannotated`, the same
  refusal name `hh_eval::scorecard` raises (ADR-0012 D6).
- **Retirement classification is a gate, not a warning**
  — a diff that is not a single-rule removal refuses
  unless `candidate_bound`; authority/budget deltas and
  multi-op changes are reported on the classification.
- **`verifiable_by` derives from the cut** — digest-only
  readers get `R0`; else the admitted entries' minimum
  resolved `claimed_level`; unresolved contributes `R0`,
  never a fabrication.
- **The public policy withholds, it does not drop** —
  `PublicationPolicy::public()` withholds `content` under
  `restricted_store`; every withheld member lands in the
  loss report (CC3).
- **Adapters name what they did not see** — Adapter B's
  transcript-reconstructed calls are `unobserved`;
  Adapter C's synthesized terminal is `reconstructed`;
  nothing is lifted `mediated` that was not mediated.
